name: Feeds - blog list / grid
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Feeds - blog list / grid.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Blog source
settings.info: Uses the current blog on blog/article pages when unselected. Choose a source on other pages.
settings.how: Choose an existing blog. Create and manage its articles in Shopify’s blog post editor.

settings.label: Optional tag filter
settings.info: Shows matching articles from the available preview (up to 50 articles), with a link to the complete tagged archive. Leave blank for native pagination.
settings.how: Enter the optional tag filter. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Posts per page
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust posts per page. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Eyebrow

settings.label: Subheading
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Show blog title link
settings.how: Turn on “Show blog title link” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
